g.text: Panel A uses h label=0.145 and complete five-frequency bands. Panel B uses h label=0.18; the expanded exterior is remeshed.
Thickness differences therefore combine exterior/PML and mesh changes; the three panel-A metrics are separate differences, not additive error bounds.
